title: carpoceras hastulatum
intro: Carpoceras hastulatum, commonly known as  Chinese gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Carpoceras hastulatum include iridoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
